_comment: How drafting agents with a shell (Codex, oss) run this project's checks in their sandboxed copy: no secrets, no network. See ~/.claude/skills/draft-agents.

tests.hint: Agents run only the restricted command set, from the project root: `tools/mm.py agent test` (tools, server and tts unit tests, and the pure Rust crates mm-core and mm-platform with a short CARGO_TARGET_DIR in TEMP), `tools/mm.py agent check` (offline checks), and the code tools: `tools/mm.py agent where NAME` (definition and uses across Rust/TS/Python/locales/docs, Tauri commands with callers, events through constants; also words from a window), `tools/mm.py agent cite FILE` (the code behind path:line references, to check your own claims before you answer), `tools/mm.py agent map` (regenerate docs/code-map.md). Since 2026-11-01 also: `tools/mm.py agent cover PATH` (the tests that cover a file and the command to run them: run them after you change it), `tools/mm.py agent gate PATCH` (triage a patch: applies?, leftovers, invariants at risk, tests to run), `tools/mm.py agent legacy [--only rust,ts,py,locales,markers,docs]` (dead-code and legacy candidates; verify each before removing). Every tool and who may run it: docs/tools.md. Read docs/code-map.md first to find files. The final OK / FAILED line is what counts.
